profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend - Full Stack - Cloud - .NET - Python - Java - PostgreSQL - AWS - ReactJS
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience in full stack, backend, and cloud development. 

I have demonstrated experience in Python, C#/.NET, Java/Spring, JavaScript, React, PostgreSQL, REST web API’s, and AWS. I am experienced with agile development processes and Professional Scrum Master I Certified. 

I've had the opportunity in my career to work with many technologies across varied industries. Some of my highlights have been designing and developing high performance API's and microservices (200k requests/second), automating AWS cloud infrastructure deployments as code, and seeing two net new full-stack applications deployed out through the entire SDLC.

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Responsible for scoring and serving threat calculations of given hashes for request rates up to 125,000 per second through the use of Python microservices on Kubernetes, caching, DynamoDB, and Aurora PostgreSQL 

- Modernized a legacy system from a physical datacenter into a cloud native service that automated the consumption of all Microsoft software and packages uploaded by internal threat teams to calculate a security trust level by leveraging Python microservices on Kubernetes, and Amazon Web Services that resulted in cost savings of ~$200,000 per year, improved scalability, availability, and maintainability

- Decoupled a tightly integrated schema from a PostgreSQL database and recreated it into its own database cluster while also reconfiguring microservices to operate with the new database, leading to cost savings of ~$5000 per year

- Automated the creation of a virtual private cloud across global regions, using Cloudformation to stand up AWS infrastructure (PostgreSQL, EC2, Lambdas, microservices on K8 nodes)

- Developed a REST API using Python, Kubernetes, and AWS that allowed internal customers to consume data on security trust levels of a file based on its hash

- Developed infrastructure charts using Helm for multiple micro services running on Kubernetes and Docker containers

- Organized and improved efficiency of big data processing on streams of files using AWS Glue jobs, Python, Numpy, and Pandas
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Docker · Amazon EKS · AWS Glue · Amazon S3 · Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) · Amazon VPC · PostgreSQL · Amazon Athena · Python (Programming Language) · AWS CloudFormation · Amazon EC2 · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · AWS Lambda

positions.title: Software Developer, Associate
positions.description:
● Developed two full stack web applications through the full software development life-cycle using ReactJS, C#, Entity Framework, and MSSQL Server for the federal compliance teams that enabled senior officers of the firm to submit the 10-K and FR Y-10 forms required by the SEC and Federal Reserve
● Inherited seven full stack web applications hosted on Pivotal Cloud Foundry and maintained applications through new features, defect resolution, and writing supporting documentation
● Built Bamboo CI/CD pipelines that deployed to Pivotal Cloud Foundry spaces for non production and production environments
● Developed REST API’s for our applications middleware using C#, .NET Core, and Entity Framework
● Designed entity relationship diagrams for our application’s database and implemented the database in MSSQL Server
● Migrated and automated 50+ tasks across our intranet’s Sharepoint Online environment through the use of Power Automate
● Developed an application using the Power Platform stack (Power Apps and Power Automate) that allowed users to submit information and write data directly into Salesforce API
● Created System Architecture and Disaster Recovery documen

positions.title: Student Software Applications Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a multi user desktop application with a GUI that allows users to scrape data from the web with Visual Basic .NET, upload to an Access database via SQL, and transform data into business models that drive investing decisions. 
- Maintained client website as well as made small improvements using Shopify’s editor and custom html/css.

positions.title: Software Application Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Developed a mobile employee repository application using Xamarin Forms with agile development team.
•	Resolved multiple front-end bugs through the use of native custom rendering and worked closely with our database engineer to resolve bugs with our applications API
•	Designed and developed a cross platform mobile application designed to serve as a craft coffee timer for my intern project
•	Worked with agile development team utilizing Scrum methodology with tools such as Jira
•	Gained exposure to NoSQL databases (MongoDB), version control (Git), and continuous integration/development (Bamboo)

volunteerExperiences.description:
Facilitate conversation during bible studies and community meetings within my assigned small group which consists of about 3-4 people
Commit to having weekly meetings with members of my small group to build deeper relationships and establish community
